name: build-remote-agent
description: Pair a phone via gbr-agent (gbr/1). Attach 127.0.0.1:8788 or gbr-mcp. Phone lists terminal windows on the PC. Scanner-ready catalog entry in LinespottingOrg/GrokBuildRemote-Agents — not OpenAI Codex core.

interface.longDescription: Catalog entry (not Codex core) so Codex / ChatGPT plugin scanners can attach Build Remote Agent. Pin-install gbr-agent from GitHub Release v0.6.0 + SHA-256. Pair with gbr-agent pair / run. Attach Bot API 127.0.0.1:8788 or gbr-mcp stdio. The phone lists terminal windows on the PC. Do not PR openai/codex.
defaultPrompt: Pin-install gbr-agent from the GitHub Release, then pair and run so the phone can spectate this terminal.
Diagnose gbr-mcp and list terminal sessions on 127.0.0.1:8788.
